text: UN experts say 3,000–4,000 Rwandan troops are fighting alongside M23 rebels in eastern Congo.
short: 3,000–4,000 Rwandan troops fighting alongside M23 in eastern Congo

source.name: UN Group of Experts on the DR Congo, final report
source.note: Final report of the UN Group of Experts on the DR Congo, S/2024/432.
source.quote: A conservative estimate of 3,000 to 4,000 RDF troops were deployed in Nyiragongo, Rutshuru and Masisi territories at the time of drafting.

additionalSources.name: The Associated Press (Edith M. Lederer), ‘UN experts: Between 3,000 and 4,000 Rwandan troops are in Congo operating with the M23 rebel group’ (republished by The Canadian Press)
additionalSources.quote: Between 3,000 and 4,000 Rwanda government forces are deployed in neighboring eastern Congo, operating alongside the M23 rebel group which has been making major advances, U.N. experts said
